environment.execution: Actual LocalGame.save and constructor, synthetic temporary base files, private region generations and authority restart. No graphics client/server launched.

tests.initial_corrections: The first fixture used the wrong Blocks.piece argument list, causing eight compilation-dependent integration errors. The next fixture had inconsistent piece type/depth and the production loader correctly rejected it. Corrected type and depth together before final passing runs. Compiler failures now show bounded stderr rather than repeated full argument lists.

implementation.scope: Byte-array base-file parser for offline versions 8 and 9 only. Produces a detached world/library/survival candidate; never mutates an existing world or legacy file. No sidecar/server import or automatic migration.
implementation.bounds: 16 MiB uncompressed source, model section bounded to 8 MiB while decoding, at most 200000 source edits, 100000 final cells, 1024 regions, 131072 final leaves; metadata at most 100000 drops/2 MiB; encoded candidate must fit existing private whole-envelope budget before return. These are diagnostic caps, not supported game limits.
implementation.decoding: Copy bounded source bytes, use existing world-model, Inventory, Protocol.Edit and ItemDrop readers with cancellation. Stream edits directly into private final-cell migration rather than build a duplicate edit list. Validate terrain version, model references, counts, health, drops and exact EOF. Encoding the candidate enforces final geometry/byte bounds before returning it.
implementation.compatibility: Retain exact model IDs, authors, unused definitions and aliases, inventory/health/drop fields, seeded terrain version, explicit air, fractional geometry and placed models. Unsupported old formats reject rather than assume their codecs.

fixture_provenance: LocalGame.save wrote isolated synthetic version-8 and version-9 fixtures. The terrain-version header was changed to 1, 2 or 3 for the six replay cohorts, then the current production LocalGame constructor loaded each as the oracle. All temporary files are removed. No private or existing user saves were read.
cases: Six synthetic production-writer fixtures: v8/v9 times terrain 1/2/3; candidate seed/version matches loaded source
Full cell, fractional glass, explicit air over seeded terrain, legacy and extended model cells match WorldVoxels replay of the production loader edits; untouched seeded geometry matches
Exact model definitions, unused alias ID75, authors, survival fields and dropped-item coordinates retained
Candidate published as a private generation and reopened through the private authority; survival state and unused model survive
Legacy source bytes stay unchanged; cancellation/interruption reject, then retry returns identical candidate bytes
Unsupported source version, invalid terrain/health, edit/drop count bounds, invalid position, missing placed-model dependency, duplicate drops, truncation, trailing data and oversize input reject
playtest: Playtest: actual LocalGame save/load CLI to private importer and private generation restart. Expected geometry, dependencies and survival fields to match the existing loader without changing source bytes; observed passed for six fixtures and 91 rejection cases. Fresh actual child exit 0 and result captured and visually inspected. Browser/game playtesting does not apply to this tools-only importer. All 224 native game/harness source hashes match prior game workflow.
hosted_observation: Exact parent db970e8d has eight successful platform build entries; publication skipped. These results do not cover pending edits.
limitations: No LocalGame/server migration integration, versions 3..7, city-sidecar/simulation state, server-player data, automatic replacement or ordinary-edit persistence. Legacy source lacks a CRC; valid legacy field parsing does not add source-authenticity guarantees. Count/byte bounds are not a peak-memory or owner-thread latency measurement. Existing private and production caps remain. No directory fsync/power-loss or full city/maximum claim.
qualification: Full city/maximum admission, 20-run memory/frame/tick/traffic budgets, physical GPU and shaped-network/32-rendered-client qualification remain pending. Stable rollout stays gated.
